New early access game Arena is our now!

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/655200/Arena/] CLICK HERE FOR STORE PAGE[/url]

Arena is a different kind of Drone game from Surreal Game Studios. It is a multiplayer deathmatch and team deathmatch games with drones. Arena is also using Surreal Framework, that means you can use same avatar and drone setup for all Surreal games. If you play Drone Fighters, you can upgrade and customize your drone and go back to Arena and use the same setup.

Download the demo and try it now!

notes.title: UPDATE v 1.01 - Controller Options
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28535551/22189802174c21dea2aae1769de9943b55d3e40d.jpg[/img]

- New Control Modes added for Motion Controls
- Control Option 1 (Arcade Mode): This is same mode as before. It’s the recommended arcade mode. You use motion of the controller, tilting and bending your wrist to travel around. To go up and down, you use analog / touch pad.
- Control Option 2 (Mix Mode): This is very similar to first mode but we give more control on analog. Meaning You still use tilting wrist to go forward and backward. In order to go left, right, up and down you use analog or touch pad. This mode might feel a bit simpler for you if you are experienced gamer with regular gamepad.
- Control Option 3 (Analog Mode): This mode mimics real life drone RC. Motion/tilting is not used in this mode. It’s all about analogs. 
- Some bug fixes and improvements.
- Please keep sending your feedback. You are very helpful. Thank you 😊
